# Vendored SVCv4 reference implementation

Source: https://github.com/clingen-data-model/svcv4-model

Pinned commit: ef66faff51a265fef7b5c4e6439905f3aa540c46

The source, schemas, and tests are copied unchanged under the included MIT LICENSE.
This is a draft, non-authoritative reference scorer. ClinGen CSpec is authoritative.
See ../../svcv4.py for SchemaBio's integration adapter. Updating the pin requires
conformance tests and a new stored rule version; never silently reinterpret saved inputs.
